parts:
I did recently update to Mojave OS, and have had issues with other packages.

pls reinstall your r and all the r packages.


On Fri, Nov 9, 2018 at 4:32 PM <jonna...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

treeio v 1.6.0
ggtree v 1.14.1

I am having a problem plotting metadata from a beast tree, specifically "posterior' but it seems to be the same for all the data.

Example taken from the Tree Annotation vignette, slightly modified:
```
file <- system.file("extdata/BEAST", "beast_mcc.tree", package="treeio")
beast <- read.beast(file)
ggtree(beast)  + geom_nodelab(aes(x=branch, label=round(posterior, 2)), vjust=-.5, size=3)
```
always results in
``` Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : object 'posterior' not found```

In this example tree "beast", and in my own tree, I can see that indeed posterior does exist. I've searched around quite a bit and can't find any problems like this. Does anyone know why this is happening?

I did recently update to Mojave OS, and have had issues with other packages.

Thanks,
Jon


--
G Yu, DK Smith, H Zhu, Y Guan, TTY Lam*. ggtree: an R package for visualization and annotation of phylogenetic trees with their covariates and other associated data, Methods in Ecology and Evolution, 2017, 8(1):28-36. doi:10.1111/2041-210X.12628
 
Homepage: https://guangchuangyu.github.io/software/ggtree
